```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/cv_helpers.R")
library(glue)
cv <- yaml::read_yaml("_data/cv_data.yml")
publications <- read_collection("publications")
talks        <- read_collection("talks")
invited      <- talks[has_category(talks$categories, "Invited talk"), ]
presentations<- talks[!has_category(talks$categories, "Invited talk"), ]
teaching     <- read_collection("teaching")

email2 <- if (length(cv$emails) > 1) {
  glue(" and \\href{{mailto:{cv$emails[[2]]}}}{{{cv$emails[[2]]}}}")
} else ""
```
